note: What the Bloch L2 accepts, for the Bloch DEX site's Bloch L2 route while that route is not live (frontend/src/multichain/bloch-l2.ts). not-enabled: the L2 runs its deposit-only launch release (docs/MAINNET-700770-PACKAGE.md), which takes no user transaction, so the first precondition of the deployment runbook (docs/MAINNET-READINESS.md, section 6: the L2 accepts user transactions) does not hold and the exchange cannot be deployed there. Set enabled in a reviewed change once an L2 release that accepts user transactions is the one in production. The page reads this field for that one sentence and for nothing else: the route goes live by dex-mainnet.record.json and frontend.network.json alone, and a live route does not show this field. The release gate of the Bloch DEX site does read it (frontend/scripts/check-production-bundle.mjs --multichain, review R416-2): a build in which those two files make the Bloch L2 route live is refused while this file says not-enabled, so publishing that route on the Bloch DEX site takes the reviewed change that sets enabled here.
